findings.summary: The active exact-location Toast storefront and current local records confirm Cubano's Restaurant Bethesda at 4907 Cordell Avenue despite the disconnected former official Wix domain.

Fresh inventory found 124 in-scope presentations across five live submenus. Twenty-one duplicate or size/service presentations were consolidated to 103 products; 111 alcohol-only listings and the zero-dollar generic Menu special artifact were excluded.

No formal allergen matrix or cross-contact policy was found after all four searches. Ten products retain only explicit named-ingredient allergen positives from Toast; every other product is marked unavailable, with no inferred negatives.
Older search-indexed Toast material still mentions Cuban Hour and Pizza Cubana, but the fresh live storefront no longer exposes that submenu or product. The frozen Pizza Cubana row is stale.
